items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 as an electrical appliance physically damaged by overvoltage from lightning, but subject to the EUR 5,000 appliance sub-limit (incl. VAT) for all affected appliances in the event. Reference Cases 1 and 9 show that similar speaker system lines were not indemnified above ~336 EUR, with the lowest proven too high. No evidence of a higher pre-loss value or special features.

Explicitly excluded by 7.1.8(b): carriage, freight, delivery, dispatch, packaging, postage, transport, logistics and comparable charges for bringing replacement property to the insured location are not indemnified, regardless of how invoiced. Reference Cases 1 and 9 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.

Explicitly excluded by 7.1.8(c): fitting, mounting, installing, connecting, commissioning, setting up, calibrating, configuring, programming, pairing, demonstrating or instructing in the use of replacement property is not indemnified. Reference Cases 1 and 9 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.

Covered under 2.3.3 as an electrical appliance physically damaged by overvoltage from lightning, subject to the EUR 5,000 appliance sub-limit (incl. VAT) for all affected appliances in the event. Reference Cases 1 and 9 show TV set lines indemnified between 517 and 616 EUR for similar claims. No evidence of a higher pre-loss value or special features.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: Not indemnified: 3.1.4 excludes liability risks and any charge for handling or assessing such claims unless the physical-damage element is separately itemised and priced. Reference Cases 1 and 9 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics - service order
items.rationale: Not indemnified: 3.1.4 and 3.1.5 exclude charges for placing, registering, administering or executing an order under a service, maintenance or liability arrangement. Reference Cases 1 and 9 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.

Excluded by 7.1.8(d) unless incurred on the same invoice as indemnifiable work. Here, all other lines on this invoice are excluded, so this vehicle cost is also excluded. Reference Cases 1 and 9 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.
